200.description: Every reservation created against this demandRef (possibly empty), in this service's default order.

items.description: A specific StockUnit and quantity a Reservation drew from, plus the pick location: the bin that StockUnit sits in (ADR 0025).

binId.description: Pick location — the bin the allocated StockUnit sits in, i.e. where a picker goes to fulfil this allocation. Always present for allocations made by this version; omitted only for a legacy allocation whose bin could not be backfilled.

items.title: Allocation

createdAt.description: Timestamp this reservation was created, RFC 3339.

expiresAt.description: Timestamp this reservation auto-expires if never confirmed or revoked, RFC 3339.

400.description: The demandRef query parameter is missing or empty.

schema.description: RFC 7807 (Problem Details for HTTP APIs) error shape, used for every non-2xx response across this service.

type.description: A URI identifying the error category (does not need to resolve). Unique per distinct error category in this service.

title.description: Fixed, human-readable summary of the error category.

status.description: Duplicates the HTTP status code as an integer (RFC 7807 requirement).

detail.description: The specific error message for this occurrence.

instance.description: The request path that produced this error.

schema.title: Problem
